subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw core recognize `openclaw-even-g2-node` with signed `platform: "even-hub"` and `deviceFamily: "glasses"` as a canonical native setup-code bootstrap client that receives the existing bounded operator handoff?
rationale: The patch is narrow and covered, but the choice changes a Gateway auth trust boundary and creates a durable wire identity for an external glasses app; automation cannot choose that product/security contract.

options.title: Approve after rebase
options.body: Accept the proposed identity contract, require the conflict rebase, and leave app placement and command policy to the related issue.

options.title: Rename or generalize first
options.body: Ask the contributor to use a maintainer-preferred durable client id and refresh proof against the external app before merge.

options.title: Keep external for now
options.body: Do not add a core bootstrap identity yet; keep Even Hub on generic node/plugin paths until maintainers choose the broader ownership model.

recommendation.title: Approve after rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed identity contract, require the conflict rebase, and leave app placement and command policy to the related issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from current Gateway auth/protocol history and CODEOWNERS/security-sensitive path context.
